title: Digital Electronics

sections.heading: 1. Boolean Algebra & De Morgan
sections.proseLatex: Laws of Boolean algebra, De Morgan's theorems: $\overline{A+B} = \bar{A}\cdot\bar{B}$, $\overline{AB} = \bar{A}+\bar{B}$.

sections.heading: 2. Logic Gates & Universal Realization
sections.proseLatex: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR. NAND and NOR are universal gates.

keyFormulas.label: Universal Gates
keyFormulas.latex: NAND or NOR can implement any logic function

wbjeebTraps: NAND = NOT of AND; NOR = NOT of OR.
Any Boolean function can be built from NAND gates alone.
